narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -5.23 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.07525-0.07609 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.07652; the first objective pays 1.28R at 0.07471.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.07652 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 23/100 — trend broken, flow fading, liq magnets below

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $573k -2.6% below · short liq $125k +3.9% above
